card.name: Above/below thresholds and odd digits
card.fires_on: Two loosely related spots: the words above or below right before a threshold value, and a single digit or unit (7 in a year like 1878, mg after 2) inside a number or dose. The pole's firing is weak and mixed.

modes.example: keep the first ammonia of the morning<< below>> the ULN for age.

modes.label: digit or unit in a number
modes.description: A single digit inside a year, or mg right after a small dose number.
modes.example: and on Day 15 to 2<< mg>> once daily.
